summary.intent: Investigate and fix someguy v0.11.1 IPNS routing failures on staging, then implement a fallback mechanism to delegated-ipfs.dev with Prometheus metrics, and fix the long-standing release-please tagging deadlock.
summary.outcome: Someguy IPNS endpoints now work with corrected Docker config (libp2p port exposed, accelerated DHT, higher resource limits). API-level fallback to delegated-ipfs.dev was implemented with Prometheus counters. The root cause of the release-please deadlock was identified (staging tags matching root package tag pattern) and a fix was committed changing staging tag format from `v{version}-staging-rc-{n}` to `staging-v{version}-rc-{n}`.

repo: Someguy v0.11.1 IPNS failures were caused by missing libp2p port 4004 exposure, standard DHT mode instead of accelerated, insufficient resources (0.5 CPU/768MB vs 1.0 CPU/2GB needed), and low connection limits (50/300 vs 100/3000).

The release-please tagging deadlock was caused by staging pre-release tags (`v0.26.x-staging-rc-N`) matching release-please's root package tag pattern (`v{version}`), causing it to find 4 of 5 expected releases and fail with 'Missing 1 paths: .'
release-please has never successfully auto-created tags since the major refactor — all prior `v*` releases were created manually, which is why it can't find a valid anchor for path '.'
`packages/crypto` existed at v0.25.1 but was missing from both release-please-config.json and .release-please-manifest.json, preventing independent versioning.
The someguy image ships `curl` but NOT `wget` — CodeRabbit's comment about wget healthchecks was correct. The wget healthcheck appeared to work locally because docker exec uses the host shell.

DelegatedRoutingClient resolve flow always queries DB even when network resolves successfully; DB wins on sequence number because publishing to someguy is fire-and-forget while DB write is synchronous.
vitest does not auto-load .env files into process.env — env vars must be passed explicitly (e.g., `THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET=x pnpm test`) or configured in vitest.config.ts.
The throttler bypass uses a secret header (`x-throttle-bypass`), not NODE_ENV=test — `THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET` must be set in both the API .env and test runner environment.

code.finding: Added API-level fallback: primary (someguy) tried first with full retry logic; fallback URL used only after primary exhausts all retries. Added 'primary' | 'fallback' literal type for backend param.
Added two new Prometheus counters: cipherbox_delegated_routing_requests_total{operation, backend, outcome} and cipherbox_delegated_routing_fallbacks_total{operation}
resolveRecord() queries both delegated routing and DB, but always prefers DB because DB write is synchronous while DHT publish is fire-and-forget — DB sequence number always wins
Someguy healthcheck changed from wget to curl -sf; libp2p port 4004 now exposed TCP+UDP; DHT mode accelerated; memory 2GB; CPU 1.0
Staging tag format changed from v{version}-staging-rc-{n} to staging-v{version}-rc-{n} to prevent collision with release-please root package tag pattern

workflow: vitest does not auto-load .env files — pass env vars directly on the command line or configure via vitest.config.ts envFile option.

release-please deadlock pattern: if staging tags start with 'v', they get matched to the root package tag pattern during release discovery, causing 'Missing N paths' errors and the 'untagged merged release PRs outstanding - aborting' deadlock.
When release-please logs 'Expected N releases, only found N-1' and 'Missing 1 paths: .', the root package has no valid release anchor — it will walk the entire commit history and then abort.
Docker healthchecks with CMD-SHELL run inside the container, not on the host — always verify tool availability inside the specific image rather than assuming host tools are available.

Someguy p99 latency is better than delegated-ipfs.dev (1.27s vs 1.62s for createFolder) despite higher p50 — self-hosted provides more predictable tail latency at the cost of median throughput (~22% lower ops/s).

friction: SDK E2E tests returned 429s even after setting NODE_ENV=test because the throttler uses a bypass header secret, not an environment variable — required discovering ThrottlerBypassGuard and the THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET mechanism.
vitest didn't load the .env file automatically, requiring a second debugging round after the first test run still returned 429s.
CodeRabbit flagged curl vs wget twice (once correctly, once incorrectly as a follow-up) — required actually exec-ing into the container to verify which tools were available.

release-please has been broken since the major refactor with multiple failed fix attempts (#300, #307, #311, #312, #313, #317, #322) — the staging tag collision root cause was only discovered by reading full unfiltered CI logs.
Background tasks completing and firing notifications while unrelated work was in progress caused context confusion.
User had to interrupt several times when analysis was going in circles or repeating previously-tried fixes.
open_items: Manually create v0.26.1 GitHub Release with proper release-please metadata to serve as anchor for path '.' and unblock future auto-tagging.
Fix PR #323's label from 'autorelease: pending' to 'autorelease: tagged' after creating the v0.26.1 tag.
Delete or re-tag old staging pre-releases (v0.26.0-staging-rc-1, v0.26.2-staging-rc-1) that still match the old pattern and may confuse release-please.
packages/crypto was added to release-please config but needs its bootstrap SHA or initial manifest entry verified to ensure it doesn't cause a 656-commit history walk.
DB-first IPNS resolution means 100% of resolves hit the database — if DB load becomes a concern, the fix is to return network result when sequence numbers match instead of always preferring DB.
The mock-ipns-routing service is now redundant for local dev (someguy handles it) but kept for CI — consider documenting this distinction more explicitly.

Someguy metrics scraping was restored in Alloy config but no Grafana dashboard panels were created for the new fallback counters — alert on rate(cipherbox_delegated_routing_fallbacks_total[5m]) > 0 still needs to be configured.
Load test metrics JSON files were saved but not committed — staging deploy workflow now points at someguy but comparative performance data is untracked.
